description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Fetch and read the web] Fetches one public page and returns a SHA-256 hash of its main text plus the clean text; if you send the previous hash or text it also says changed yes/no and, with previous text, lists added and removed lines. Input: url, optional previous_hash or previous_text. Limits: 1.5 MB page, 100,000 characters of text returned; robots.txt obeyed. Not cached.

previous_text.description: text from your previous call (gives the changed lines; POST for long text)

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: page_diff

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Page change check: content hash, clean text and line diff ($0.002/call)
